name: WAnet
summary: Perth ISP (WAnet); office on Beaufort Street, Mount Lawley in the early 2000s with OPAL dial-in modem pools; broadband, hosting and 'premium internet services and support'; still active.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of wanet.com.au Jun 1997; staffed in Perth from at least Apr 1997.
